description: Enforces the Estate Model publish order: Substack → LinkedIn Article → LinkedIn Post Hub → External Spokes. Each stage has URL dependencies on the previous stage. BLOCKs any distribution attempt where upstream dependencies are not yet live.
litmus: Run HOW.py with campaign_file and target — exit 0=dependencies satisfied (safe to publish), exit 1=BLOCK (dep not live), exit 2=WARN (cannot determine).

files.HOW.py: Enforcement gate — check publish dependencies for a target spoke/hub/source
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance audit — detect past out-of-order distribution attempts
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — signal workflow gap if sequence violations exceed 25%

estate_order: 4. all external spokes (X, Reddit, Instagram, Facebook) — require post_hub live
origin_incident: 2026-05-07: Estate model dependency chain formalized. Spokes drive to Post Hub which references Article URL. Publishing out of order produces broken cross-links.
